item.tib: ye srid 'phrul gyi ju thig mo mtsho srid pa'i sgron ma snang srid legs nyes kun gsal
item.coloph: zhes 'phrul gyi ju tig gi lag len nye bar mkho ba'i tshogs phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'di ni/ mdo smad kyi thos chung snyom las pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis ju tig rgyud 'bum dang / mdud rdzong / khra mo 'byung ba'i khog brdung nag rigs srid pa'i gzhung khrol/ to mo a par snyan rgyud/ gling gzhi nyi ma'i 'khor rtsis/ bram ze klu yi ber nag bcu gsum 'khor rtsis chen mo/ dpyad don rgyu ma gser 'bum la sogs/ mdor na mo dpe dum pa bcu kha long tsam gyi/ snying po bsdus nas bkod pa bkra shis so//
